description: Performs a physical drag from a known source to a target, coordinate, or relative offset; prefer canonical ids, use stable selectors as fallback, and use coordinates only as a last resort.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the drag source and destination.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the drag source.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID for the drag source.

toSelector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the drag destination.

toId.description: Preferred canonical element ID for the drag destination.

dx.description: Relative horizontal drag offset when not using an explicit destination.

dy.description: Relative vertical drag offset when not using an explicit destination.

purpose.description: Describe the intended drag effect, e.g., moving a slider, reordering an item, or dragging one element onto another

purposeHint: Describe the intended drag effect, e.g., moving a slider, reordering an item, or dragging one element onto another
